```artifact
Feature: Software Engineering Process Coordination and Hospital Services

  Scenario: Coordination of Software Engineering Process Activities
    Given the Software Engineering process is initiated
    When all activities are coordinated
    Then the process activities are managed as specified

  Scenario: Guidance by Prof. Chandrasekaran and Staff
    Given the Software Engineering process is underway
    When guided by Prof. Chandrasekaran and other esteemed staff of NITK Computer Science & Engineering Department
    Then the guidance is provided as specified

  Scenario Outline: Hospital Provides Quality Medicines via Authorized Chemists
    Given the Hospital has decided to provide quality medicines
    When the medicines are provided via authorized Chemists located <location>
    Then the medicines are provided at discounted prices as specified

    Examples:
      | location       |
      | within the zone|

  Scenario Outline: Hospital Provides Door-step Laboratory Services
    Given the Hospital has decided to provide door-step Laboratory services
    When the services are provided via specimen collection <location>
    Then the services are provided wherever possible as specified

    Examples:
      | location       |
      | within the zone|
```
